result.summary: The environment features sidewalks and street lighting but lacks marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals at a signalized intersection. The presence of embedded trolley tracks and lack of clear crossing infrastructure increases risk for pedestrians navigating the space.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated path.

hazards.name: Embedded Rail Tracks
hazards.description: Trolley tracks in the roadway create uneven surfaces that are trip hazards and can be slippery when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending through the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While vehicle signals are present, there are no visible pedestrian-specific signal heads to indicate safe crossing times.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban street with a signalized intersection and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and pedestrian signals are present, the environment is compromised by faded crosswalk markings and the presence of trolley tracks in the roadway.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded metal tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slipping hazard for cyclists, especially when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and extending down the street

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and degradation of the asphalt around the tracks and in the intersection area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement and Track Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair degraded pavement around the trolley tracks to ensure a level surface for all road users.

result.summary: The environment features a wide roadway with trolley tracks and a marked zebra crosswalk at a signalized intersection. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the long crossing distance and visual obstructions from parked cars near the intersection reduce pedestrian safety.
